name: ISG 5506
title: Genetic Counseling Fieldwork Rotation VI - Spring Second Year
description: The last of six experiential supervised fieldwork placements applying genetic counseling theory from the classroom to practical clinical and non-clinical professional settings to support the development of genetic counseling practice-based competencies.
requirement_description: Open to graduate genetic counseling professional science master's students who have completed ISG 5504. Corequisite: ISG 5505.
